demoDescription: Fictional schools. No real student data.

schoolReadyBody: Your school has its own verified host and isolated data.
identityBody: Switch between your memberships without signing out. Permissions follow your active role.
makeItYours: Make it feel like your school
brandBody: Choose an accessible accent colour and preview your workspace before publishing.
operationsBody: Open School modules for records, attendance, leave, fees and examinations.
phaseNotice: Development preview · Use fictional data for testing
accessSubtitle: The people and role memberships in this school. All access is checked on the server.
name: Name
auditSubtitle: Sensitive reads and record changes are recorded. Entries cannot be edited or deleted.
brandSubtitle: Choose your school app design, customise it and preview before publishing.
contrastHelp: Colours are automatically adjusted to meet WCAG AA contrast against white.
previewHeading: Every school day, a little simpler.
previewBody: Today’s priorities. One clear next step.
aiSubtitle: Helpful drafts, with people in control. Core workflows always work with AI off.
aiDisabledBody: No model receives school data. A provider must pass contract, privacy and language checks before it can be enabled.
prompt: What would you like to draft?
promptPlaceholder: For example: create five questions about the water cycle…
noPersonal: Use only public educational content. Do not include names, contact details, IDs or school records.
noRequests: No AI requests yet. Any request you make will appear here.
settingsSubtitle: Clear controls for your school. Every change is audited.
capHelp: 100 paise = ₹1. A cap of 0 pauses all AI calls.
sessionPolicy: Sessions expire after 15 minutes and rotate on refresh. Sign-in lasts up to 8 hours.
hostPolicy: Sessions are bound to this school’s host. They cannot be reused on another school’s address.
privacyBody: This local preview contains fictional accounts only. No analytics, ad network or AI provider is active. Schools control their educational data; the platform processes it on their behalf. Production privacy notices, consent and data processing agreements require legal review before launch.
termsBody: Local development preview. Use fictional data only. This build is not approved for school operations, payments or public launch. Production service terms, school verification and legal review are pending.
roadmapSubtitle: The full specification is delivered in phases. Each phase needs tests and a working demo before it closes.
phase0Detail: Monorepo, tenancy, auth, permissions, audit, themes, translations and AI guardrails.

reviewPending: Core modules are available for testing. See docs/STATUS.md for coverage and unfinished features.

restricted: Access is limited by your active role.
